title: Claude checks before changing something load-bearing
blurb: Ask for a small fix and Claude sometimes rewrites your setup files, your lockfile, or your instructions too. This makes it stop and check with you before touching anything like that.
newcomerProblem: You asked for one small change and Claude quietly edited files you never mentioned.

installs.content:
## Staying in scope

Only change the files needed for what was actually asked.

- Do not rename, reformat, or reorganise anything that wasn't part of the request.
- Do not "tidy up" nearby code while you're in a file.
- If a fix seems to need changes elsewhere, say so and ask first.
- If a request is ambiguous, ask rather than picking the broader reading.

tryThis: Ask Claude to make a small change, then check git status
tryThisExplain: Only the files you expected should show up as changed.
explain: Two things happen here. Claude gets a written rule to only touch what you asked about. And a check runs automatically before it edits certain files — your setup, your instructions, lockfiles, build files — so those always need your say-so, no matter what Claude decided.
honestLimit: It can't know what you asked for, so it guards a fixed list of files that are costly to get wrong. It won't catch every unwanted edit.
